## Checklist

- [ ] The change is in `src/`, not in the built pages alone
- [ ] `sh build.sh` was run in `src/`, and the rebuilt pages are in this pull request
- [ ] `node test.js` passes: no script errors, sideways scrolling, empty read-outs or figures never drawn
- [ ] Numbers and claims that are new have a source, or are marked in the guide's notes as assumed or calculated
- [ ] A drawing that is a cartoon, or a model that is simplified, says so in its caption
- [ ] US spelling and plain language
- [ ] If an opening figure or a title changed, `node ogimages.js` was run and the pictures are included

Releases (the release number, `CHANGELOG.md`, the tag) are made by NE-CAT after review, so leave those as they are.
